versions.shortDescription: Runs hierarchical agglomerative clustering and generates a dendrogram image and summary report.
versions.longDescription:
# agglomerative-clustering

Runs hierarchical agglomerative clustering and generates a dendrogram image and summary report.

## Input and outputs

Provide a numeric CSV table as `features`. The implementation fits Ward/Euclidean
agglomerative clustering on the first four columns. Supply feature columns without
an identifier column.

- `dendrogram_png`: a PNG file containing the SciPy dendrogram.
- `report`: a plain-text summary of the fitted cluster count.
- Metrics: `samples` and `clusters`, calculated from the fitted result.

`distance_threshold` controls the clustering cut; its default `0.0` builds the full
hierarchy. `plot_title`, `dendrogram_truncate_mode`, and `dendrogram_p` control the
plot. The existing `linkage`, `metric`, `standardize`, `compute_distances`,
`use_distance_threshold`, and `n_clusters` fields are retained for compatibility;
the current fitting implementation does not apply those settings.

## Development

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
cp .env.example .env
# Set APP_ID and platform URLs in .env before connecting.
python main.py
```

The Docker base image provides the FL-Net API. `requirements.txt` contains only
additional runtime dependencies; `requirements-dev.txt` includes the API for local development.

Build with `docker build -t tool-agglomerative-clustering .`.
The image runs as `nonroot` and uses Matplotlib's headless Agg backend.

hyperparams.description: Linkage strategy for hierarchical merges. Note: 'ward' requires metric='euclidean'.
hyperparams.name: linkage

hyperparams.description: Store distances between merged clusters (needed for plotting an accurate dendrogram in some settings).
hyperparams.name: compute_distances

hyperparams.description: Standardize features to zero mean / unit variance before clustering (recommended).
hyperparams.name: standardize

hyperparams.description: Distance metric for clustering (ignored when linkage='ward', which always uses euclidean).
hyperparams.name: metric

hyperparams.description: If true, build the full tree with distance_threshold=0 and n_clusters=None to enable a dendrogram.
hyperparams.name: use_distance_threshold

hyperparams.description: Number of clusters to cut the tree into (used only if use_distance_threshold=false).
hyperparams.name: n_clusters

hyperparams.description: Truncation mode for the dendrogram plot. 'none' shows the full tree; 'lastp' keeps the last P leaves; 'level' shows the last P merging levels.
hyperparams.name: dendrogram_truncate_mode

hyperparams.description: Parameter P for truncate_mode 'lastp' or 'level' (ignored when truncate_mode='none').
hyperparams.name: dendrogram_p

hyperparams.description: Height at which to cut the dendrogram to form clusters (used only if use_distance_threshold=true). Set to 0.0 to compute the full tree like in the scikit-learn example.
hyperparams.name: distance_threshold

input.description: Numeric feature table. The first four columns are used for clustering; provide features without an identifier column.
input.name: features

output.description: PNG file containing the dendrogram plot.
output.name: dendrogram_png

output.description: Plain-text summary of the fitted cluster count.
output.name: report

lang-pkgs-python-pkg.Title: setuptools: Path Traversal Vulnerability in setuptools PackageIndex
lang-pkgs-python-pkg.Description: setuptools is a package that allows users to download, build, install, upgrade, and uninstall Python packages. A path traversal vulnerability in `PackageIndex` is present in setuptools prior to version 78.1.1. An attacker would be allowed to write files to arbitrary locations on the filesystem with the permissions of the process running the Python code, which could escalate to remote code execution depending on the context. Version 78.1.1 fixes the issue.
